Hi Priya,

I am applying for the Product Designer role at Cruitical, as I was drawn to your AI-native approach that evaluates how candidates actually work before the first interview.

With a B.Tech in Computer Science, I bring dev handoff credibility and strong technical feasibility conversations to product teams. During my work at Ascent Business Solutions, I built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time across one hundred plus digital and print creatives while collaborating directly with stakeholders.

My B2B case study Bounceless demonstrates a cleaner verification experience for teams that depend on accurate email lists: https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/

Would you be open to taking a quick look at that case study at your convenience this week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
